name: Astral Reef Shark Expanse
introDiscord: An open expanse stretches beyond the reef wall, crossed by fast currents and distant silhouettes.
introTwitch: An open expanse stretches beyond the reef wall, crossed by fast currents and distant silhouettes.

bluewater-margin.name: Bluewater Margin
bluewater-margin.prompt: Bluewater surrounds a narrow margin where three courses leave the sheltering coral.

left.message: Beyond Bluewater Margin, a restorative current shaped by Astral Reef Shark Expanse gathers in a quiet basin.
left.fullHpMessage: The restorative magic of Astral Reef Shark Expanse finds no wounds to mend. You are already at full HP.

right.message: Within Astral Reef Shark Expanse, the right path from Bluewater Margin reveals a hidden Moonkeeper cache.

forward.message: The water folds around Astral Reef Shark, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

predator-meridian.name: Predator Meridian
predator-meridian.prompt: A meridian of pale stones points toward three routes across the exposed sea.

left.message: The water folds around Astral Reef Shark, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

right.message: Beyond Predator Meridian, a restorative current shaped by Astral Reef Shark Expanse gathers in a quiet basin.
right.fullHpMessage: The restorative magic of Astral Reef Shark Expanse finds no wounds to mend. You are already at full HP.

forward.message: Within Astral Reef Shark Expanse, the forward path from Predator Meridian reveals a hidden moon-shell coffer.

open-reef-run.name: Open Reef Run
open-reef-run.prompt: The open reef run widens around three channels beneath a restless surface.

left.message: Within Astral Reef Shark Expanse, the left path from Open Reef Run reveals a hidden Fae offering vessel.

right.message: The water folds around Astral Reef Shark, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

forward.message: A quiet recess beyond Open Reef Run preserves a dormant Fae shrine, but offers no material reward.

boss-antechamber.name: Apex Gyre
boss-antechamber.prompt: A powerful presence shifts beyond the final threshold while the surrounding reef falls still.

bossPromptDiscord:
You reach Apex Gyre. The water tightens around an unseen guardian whose presence fills the chamber.
Use /yes to continue or /no to retreat for now.
bossPromptTwitch: Apex Gyre: An unseen guardian stirs beyond the threshold. Use !yes to continue or !no to retreat.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Apex Gyre. The hidden guardian remains beyond the threshold.

boss.revealText: The chamber answers with a surge of reef magic. Astral Reef Apex reveals itself!

completionText: Astral Reef Apex yields to the returning current. Astral Reef Shark Expanse settles into a quieter rhythm, and another route through the Moonlit Reef becomes clear.
